item.title: Gaza death toll tops 74,475 as seven Palestinians killed in 24 hours

item.title: Araghchi calls for balanced OIC resolution on Yemen
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says Tehran may openly object to a proposed resolution on Yemen at the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) if the final text fails to reflect fairness and balance, adding that Iran’s position will depend on the wording ultimately adopted.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86296062/Araghchi-calls-for-balanced-OIC-resolution-on-Yemen

Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says Tehran may openly object to a proposed resolution on Yemen at the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) if the final text fails to reflect fairness and balance, adding that Iran’s position will depend on the wording ultimately adopted.

item.title: Defense minister undermines Trump’s new anti-Iran threats
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — The newly appointed defense minister of Iran, Mehrdad Akhlaghi-Ketabchi, has reacted to the US president’s bluster, saying that the necessary measures to counter threats have been devised, and if US President Donald Trump’s threats turn from rhetoric into action, he will see the result.

item.title: Iran’s Dogharoun accounts for 52% of cargo transit to Afghanistan: Official

item.content:encoded:
